name: select-basic
sql: SELECT id FROM users

name: cte-simple
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM users) SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-column-alias
sql: WITH x(id) AS (SELECT id FROM users) SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-multiple
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM users), y AS (SELECT id FROM x) SELECT id FROM y

name: cte-where-ilike
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM users WHERE name ILIKE 'a%') SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-join-on
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT u.id FROM users u JOIN accounts a ON a.user_id = u.id) SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-join-using
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM users JOIN accounts USING (id)) SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-group-having
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT user_id AS id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-window
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id, LAG(id) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS previous_id FROM users) SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-filter
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT user_id AS id, SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open') AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id) SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-subquery
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders)) SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-set-body
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM users UNION SELECT user_id AS id FROM orders) SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-root-union
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM users) SELECT id FROM x UNION ALL SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-order-limit-offset
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 1) SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-nested-nonrecursive
sql: WITH x AS (WITH y AS (SELECT id FROM users) SELECT id FROM y) SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-subquery-reference
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM users) SELECT q.id FROM (SELECT id FROM x) q

name: cte-physical-join
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM users) SELECT x.id FROM x JOIN audit_log a ON a.id = x.id

name: cte-quoted-identifier
sql: WITH "CaseCte" AS (SELECT id FROM users) SELECT id FROM "CaseCte"

name: cte-postfix-cast
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM events WHERE created_at::date >= DATE '2026-01-01') SELECT id FROM x

name: cte-interval
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT id FROM events WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 day') SELECT id FROM x

name: root-intersect
sql: SELECT id FROM alpha INTERSECT SELECT id FROM beta

name: root-except
sql: SELECT id FROM alpha EXCEPT SELECT id FROM beta

name: root-intersect-all
sql: SELECT id FROM alpha INTERSECT ALL SELECT id FROM beta

name: root-except-all
sql: SELECT id FROM alpha EXCEPT ALL SELECT id FROM beta

name: join-using
sql: SELECT id FROM alpha JOIN beta USING (id)

name: join-using-multiple
sql: SELECT tenant_id, id FROM alpha JOIN beta USING (tenant_id, id)

name: recursive-cte
sql: WITH RECURSIVE x AS (SELECT 1) SELECT * FROM x

name: lateral-derived-source
sql: SELECT q.id FROM LATERAL (SELECT id FROM users) q

name: natural-join
sql: SELECT id FROM alpha NATURAL JOIN beta

name: fetch-first-only
sql: SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

name: fetch-first-with-ties
sql: SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES

name: distinct-on
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id) customer_id, created_at FROM orders ORDER BY customer_id, created_at DESC

name: nulls-last
sql: SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id NULLS LAST

name: aggregate-filter
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open') FROM orders

name: window-frame
sql: SELECT LAG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM orders

name: dollar-quoted-string
sql: SELECT $$O'Brien$$ AS value FROM users

name: tagged-dollar-quoted-string
sql: SELECT $tag$line 1 '2'$tag$ AS value FROM users

name: typed-date
sql: SELECT DATE '2026-08-21' FROM events

name: typed-timestamp-zone
sql: SELECT TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '2026-08-21T09:30:00+08:00' FROM events

name: postfix-cast
sql: SELECT created_at::date FROM events

name: interval-arithmetic
sql: SELECT created_at + INTERVAL '1 day' FROM events

name: expression-in-list
sql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id IN (other_id, ABS(1))

name: root-limit-offset
sql: SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 5

name: schema-qualified-function
sql: SELECT pg_catalog.lower(name) FROM users

name: quoted-identifier
sql: SELECT "MixedCase" FROM users

name: comma-from
sql: SELECT a.id FROM alpha a, beta b WHERE a.id = b.id

name: correlated-exists
sql: SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id)
